name: Feed-Forward 3DGS Compression
definition: Applying FCGS to compress 3DGS generated by feed-forward models (e.g., MVSplat, LGM) without retraining, demonstrating zero-shot generalization.
summary: Feed-Forward 3DGS Compression is a zero-shot post-training method that reduces storage size of feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting models without retraining, handling their irregular data structures where traditional codecs fail.
